rationale: The short thesis hasn't formally invalidated (price is still below 152.05), but the tape has turned against it: a 75-minute base near the lows is printing higher lows, the 123k-share bounce candle lifted price back above the 5m 9-EMA, and with only 38 minutes to the close the 150.45 target needs a fresh flush that isn't visible in recent candles. Meanwhile a late-day squeeze through the 151.9 flag high would stop us out for roughly 3x the current loss. Flipping long isn't justified — price remains ~4% below session VWAP, under the 151.9–152.5 resistance shelf, and still in a dominant distribution day — so closing for a small loss and standing flat into the close is the best-risk action.
